description:
About Corvus

We’re Corvus Robotics, a Physical AI company transforming how the world’s warehouses operate. By combining autonomous robotics, computer vision, and AI, we’re replacing manual, labor-intensive processes with intelligent systems that make inventory management safer, smarter, and more efficient.

Our flagship Corvus One™ drones autonomously track warehouse inventory around the clock, while Corvus Trident™, our AI-powered forklift intelligence system, captures inventory movement in real time. Together, our technologies provide a complete picture of warehouse operations, helping enterprises improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision-making.

Our technology is widely deployed and delivering value for leading enterprises. We’re now building a future where warehouse operations are fully autonomous. At Corvus, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, solve challenging real-world problems, and help bring the next generation of intelligent robots to scale.

About the Role

At Corvus Robotics, we're scaling autonomous robotics across enterprise warehouses. We're looking for a Deployment Program Manager to own the end-to-end customer deployment process, from sales handoff through successful implementation and operational readiness.

You'll serve as the central point of coordination across Sales, Engineering, Customer Success, and field deployment teams, ensuring projects move efficiently from signed agreements to fully operational Corvus One™ systems.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on ownership, cross-functional execution, and building scalable processes in a fast-growing robotics company.

This field-based role requires approximately 20–30% travel across the U.S., with occasional visits to our Mountain View headquarters. You'll work closely with customers and cross-functional teams to coordinate deployments, ensure site readiness, and drive successful implementations.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end deployment programs: Lead customer implementations from sales handoff through installation, commissioning, and operational handover.

  • Drive deployment planning: Establish project timelines, milestones, resource requirements, and clear ownership across internal teams and customers.

  • Bridge Sales and Operations: Translate customer commitments, site requirements, and commercial expectations into actionable deployment plans.

  • Coordinate cross-functional execution: Partner with Sales, Engineering, Customer Success, and field teams to keep deployments on track.

  • Manage customer readiness: Coordinate site assessments, infrastructure requirements, installation schedules, and customer dependencies.

  • Identify and resolve risks: Proactively manage blockers, escalations, scope changes, and competing priorities to protect deployment timelines.

  • Build scalable processes: Develop deployment playbooks, standardized workflows, and reporting to support growing deployment volumes.

  • Drive successful handoffs: Ensure clear acceptance criteria, customer training, and a smooth transition to ongoing operations and support.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in technical program management, deployment management, implementation, or customer-facing operations.

  • Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Experience coordinating hardware installations, robotics, industrial automation, or other technical deployments.

  • Strong project planning, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to translate technical and business requirements into clear execution plans.

  • Excellent communication skills and confidence working with enterprise customers and technical teams.

  • A hands-on, highly organized approach with the ability to drive accountability and execution in a fast-paced startup environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in robotics, warehouse automation, industrial IoT, or hardware-software integrated systems.

  • Background managing enterprise customer implementations or multi-site rollouts.

  • Familiarity with warehouse operations, logistics, networking, or site infrastructure.

  • Experience developing deployment playbooks, operational KPIs, and scalable processes.

  • Experience working closely with Sales during pre-deployment planning and post-sales handoffs.

Why Join Corvus Robotics?

Build technology that works in the real world. Be part of a team bringing autonomous robotics and AI into real-world environments, solving meaningful challenges and transforming warehouse operations.

Own your impact. Take ownership of meaningful work, contribute to important decisions, and see the direct impact of your contributions as we grow.

Help scale the next generation of Physical AI. Join at a pivotal stage of growth and help build the technology, teams, systems, and processes that will bring autonomous robotics to enterprise scale.

Grow alongside the company. Work with talented, driven people across disciplines, tackle new challenges, expand your skills, and help shape the future of Corvus Robotics.
